geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.name: abundance_validity
geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.description: EVALUATED_POSITIVE: no mode excluded, >= 1 included; EVALUATED_ZERO: no mode excluded, none included (complete abundance 0); PARTIAL_VALIDITY: some but not all modes excluded; INFLATION_INVALID_ALL: every mode excluded

geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.name: reason
geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.description: NO_MODES_ABOVE_THRESHOLD: validated spectrum without mode above H0 (lighter axions are outside the population, not absent)

geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.name: Omega_valid_modes_partial_h2_at_theta_ref
geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.description: partial sum over the valid included modes (>= 0); not the complete abundance

geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.name: theta_population
geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.description: PRIMARY: EVALUATED_POSITIVE and EVALUATED_ZERO; SENSITIVITY_ONLY: PARTIAL_VALIDITY (only in the labelled sensitivity population); EXCLUDED_NOT_EVALUATED: INFLATION_INVALID_ALL

geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.name: w_R
geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv.description: constant pre-reheating equation of state of the scenario (p = w_R rho); -1 < w_R <= 1; also written for POST/LATE/FROZEN rows, whose abundances do not depend on it

invariants: included_in_cdm_sum == (abundance_state in INCLUDED_*) == (Omega_h2_at_theta_ref is not NA)
abundance_state == INFLATIONARY_VALIDITY_EXCLUDED  <=>  not inflation_valid  (and category is recorded unchanged)
category FROZEN => abundance_state NOT_INCLUDED_FROZEN; LATE => NOT_INCLUDED_LATE
Omega_h2_at_theta_ref > 0 and finite whenever not NA
per geometry: counts sum to number_of_modes; Omega_geometry_h2_at_theta_ref == sum of master Omega_h2_at_theta_ref
global: sum over geometries reproduces the census; every scenario has 16313 rows in production

every usable geometry of the A1 canonical geometry table has one row in geometry_summary_<label>.csv and geometry_abundance_validity_<label>.csv; Omega_geometry > 0 iff number_included > 0; = 0 iff nothing included and nothing excluded (EVALUATED_ZERO); NA iff nothing included and >= 1 mode excluded
w_R is constant within a table, equals the w_R of the scenario in run_config.json, lies in (-1, 1], and PRE rows use branch fuzzy_wR0_eq2.10_2.15 iff w_R == 0 else fuzzy_wR_general_eq2.10_2.15
